chapter: Carnegie Hall and the touring years
title: Helen Humes in New York and at a recent New Orleans show
summary: He first met Helen Humes with Basie, and worked a New Orleans hotel show with her a few months ago.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: Was Helen Humes on that show?
I met Helen Humes in New York City with Count Basie. She used to sing with Count Basie, an' uh, she...I hadn't seen her in a long time.

So we went down to New Orleans...lately...here lately, and she done a show in one of the big hotels down there. We had Count Basie. He had a host of other blues singers--people I had never heard of. And they had...whaternam?
Uh, you mean Helen we were just talkin' about?
Helen. Helen Humes. She was on the show. And myself.
